svg.title: FN-01 editable table proof
svg.desc: A5 landscape card with the approved Morocco coastline reference, an observation prompt, a ruled writing area, and the source note. All visible copy remains editable text.

g.text: Follow the edge. Where does your eye pause?
Write one observation before reading the source note.

g.aria-label: Blank ruled area for one observation

text.tspan: Source note: Earth Selfie, Morocco. Landsat 8 imagery. USGS EROS Center, 2015. Public Domain.
Colors are processed imagery, not a shared scientific key.

g.text: This is an independent practice card.
